name: Open Design 0.24.1 — ✨ World’s First Design Plan
body:
## ✨ World’s First Design Plan: Affordable models for everyone

**Generous monthly allowance.** Explore and refine your designs with DeepSeek V4.1 Flash, GLM-5.3 Flash and MiMo 2.6 Flash. Get started with Go for **\$8** for your first month, or choose Plus or above for up to **\$200** in bonus credits.

**API access across your workflow.** All personal subscription tiers support API calls. Use your OpenDesign API key with Codex, Claude Code, DSH, OpenCode, Hermes and other AI agents.

**Free credits for new users.** Every new user receives approximately \$0.50 in free credits to try OpenDesign.

## 🐛 Fixed

### 🧠 Agents, runtimes and diagnostics

- **A cleanly finished run stays visibly finished.** A task-level block no longer turns a clean agent exit into a misleading failed-run card; real crashes and failed exits still remain failures. ([#8350](https://github.com/nexu-io/open-design/pull/8350)) Thanks @itscheems.
- **Support bundles retain the clues that matter.** Diagnostics now carry daemon health evidence for memory pressure, SQLite growth and unclean exits, whether you export from the app or with `od diagnostics export`. ([#8354](https://github.com/nexu-io/open-design/pull/8354)) Thanks @PerishCode.
- **Failure evidence can be collected before the trail goes cold.** With existing consent enabled, detected Agent and delivery failures queue bounded, redacted diagnostics automatically; opting out stops collection. ([#8357](https://github.com/nexu-io/open-design/pull/8357)) Thanks @Siri-Ray.
- **OD Next sandboxed runs clean up after themselves.** The run input access root remains writable for sandbox teardown instead of leaving a run stranded on cleanup. ([#8024](https://github.com/nexu-io/open-design/pull/8024)) Thanks @arqueon.
- **Fatal MCP failures say what happened.** An MCP stdio process now writes its fatal error before it exits, so the client has a usable diagnostic instead of a silent disappearance. ([#7340](https://github.com/nexu-io/open-design/pull/7340)) Thanks @lorenzozanee.

### 🖥️ Desktop and presentation

- **Updating the desktop app no longer races its own shutdown.** Renderer traffic is stopped before the packaged runtime retires, making the restart handoff safer. ([#8348](https://github.com/nexu-io/open-design/pull/8348)) Thanks @PerishCode.
- **The fullscreen exit button belongs to the theme you chose.** Its colors, hover state and keyboard focus now remain readable in both light and dark presentations. ([#7272](https://github.com/nexu-io/open-design/pull/7272)) Thanks @dennytosp.
- **A macOS MCP session can become a desktop window in place.** Opening the app after its headless runtime started now reveals the normal window without losing the local session. ([#8398](https://github.com/nexu-io/open-design/pull/8398)) Thanks @PerishCode.

### 🏠 Home and campaigns

- **The task-type menu stays open when you ask for it.** A click immediately after Home chooses a type no longer opens the picker only for it to snap shut. ([#8386](https://github.com/nexu-io/open-design/pull/8386)) Thanks @Siri-Ray.
- **A valid campaign remains present through ordinary interruptions.** Network changes, short sleeps and tab switches no longer unnecessarily remove an active campaign; cached content follows its known server schedule while offline. ([#8292](https://github.com/nexu-io/open-design/pull/8292)) Thanks @alchemistklk.
